children: Keystone Acquisition reported net income for the quarter, driven by $2.6M of trust-account investment interest and $37,500 of referral fee income, offset by $274,770 in operating costs. The company had not begun operations and generated no operating revenue.
: The blank-check company is seeking a target and expects to use substantially all trust-account funds to complete a combination.
: Investments in the trust account totaled $291.6M at September 30, 2026, including $3.4M of interest income.
: Cash outside the trust account was $894,954 at September 30, 2026.
: Management said projected liquidity raises substantial doubt about the company’s ability to continue as a going concern.
